source: SEC forms list (sec.gov/forms, 162 entries, read 13 Oct 2026) plus EDGAR submission types not on that list; rich entries written from the forms' instructions and general practice, and marked tested only where this library has been run against a real filing of that type.

entries.name: Annual report
entries.contents: Audited annual report: Item 1 business, 1A risk factors, 1C cybersecurity, 2 properties, 3 legal proceedings, 5 market for stock and buybacks, 7 MD&A (results, liquidity, non-GAAP), 7A market risk, 8 financial statements and notes (debt, leases, converts, segments, share counts), 9A controls, 10-14 governance (usually incorporated from the proxy), 15 exhibits. Cover page: shares outstanding by class, public float, fiscal year end.
entries.notes: Items 10-14 usually say 'incorporated by reference from the proxy statement': go to DEF 14A. Figures for the prior year may be restated here; say which filing a number came from.

entries.name: Quarterly report
entries.cadence: quarterly (Q1-Q3; no Q4 10-Q, the 10-K covers it)
entries.contents: Unaudited quarterly statements with the three-month and year-to-date columns, condensed notes, Part I Item 2 MD&A, Item 3 market risk, Item 4 controls; Part II: legal proceedings, risk factor updates, buybacks (Item 2), exhibits.
entries.notes: Item numbers repeat between Part I and Part II, so the 10-K section splitter does not apply; use find_in_document and get_table. 'Last nine months as of' a November date means the Q3 10-Q year-to-date column.

entries.name: Current report
entries.contents: Short cover document organised by Item number; the substance is in exhibits. Item 2.02 results of operations (earnings release, Ex 99.1), Item 1.01 material agreements (mergers, financings), Item 2.01 completed acquisitions, Item 2.03 new debt, Item 5.02 officer and director changes, Item 5.07 shareholder vote results, Item 7.01 / 8.01 other announcements, Item 9.01 exhibit list.
entries.notes: Guidance exists on EDGAR only here (Ex 99.1) or in an investor presentation (Ex 99.2). Item 5.02 is the source for 'who is the CFO as of'. Filter list_filings by form 8-K and then read the Item numbers in the body to pick the right one.

entries.name: Definitive proxy statement
entries.cadence: annual (before the annual meeting), plus special meetings
entries.contents: Director nominees and biographies, executive compensation (summary compensation table, pay versus performance, CEO pay ratio), director compensation table, compensation peer group, beneficial ownership table, auditor fees, proposals and board recommendations, related-party transactions.
entries.notes: This is where 10-K Items 10-14 actually live. Director compensation is a table near the end of the compensation section; sum the Total column for 'total director compensation'. The compensation peer group is the natural peer set for market-analysis questions.

entries.name: Merger proxy statement
entries.contents: Full description of a merger: background of the deal, fairness opinions, deal price and consideration, equity and enterprise value, projections given to advisers, termination fees, vote required.
entries.notes: The 'Background of the Merger' section is the narrative; 'Opinion of Financial Advisor' holds valuation multiples. Equity and enterprise value are usually stated in the summary.

entries.name: Registration statement for securities issued in a business combination
entries.contents: Like a merger proxy plus the acquirer's registration: deal terms, exchange ratio, pro forma financials, risk factors of the combined company.
entries.notes: Stock-for-stock deals (for example 0.7926 acquirer shares per target share) are described here and in the 8-K announcing the agreement.

entries.name: Beneficial ownership report, active holder (over 5%)
entries.cadence: event (within 5 business days) and on material change
entries.contents: Who bought, how much, purpose of the transaction (activism, control), source of funds, agreements with the issuer.

entries.name: Beneficial ownership report, passive holder (over 5%)
entries.contents: Passive holdings over 5%: holder, shares, percent of class.

entries.name: Statement of changes in beneficial ownership (insider transactions)
entries.contents: Each insider purchase, sale, grant or option exercise: date, shares, price, holdings after.
entries.notes: The data is XML (primary_doc.xml, like N-PORT); the listed primary document is the rendered page. No parser yet: read generically.

entries.name: Institutional investment manager holdings report
entries.contents: Every US-listed equity position of the manager: issuer, class, CUSIP, value, shares, voting authority.
entries.notes: Equity long positions only: no shorts, bonds, or most derivatives. The holdings table is a separate XML document in the filing. No parser yet.

entries.name: Notice of proposed sale of restricted or control securities
entries.contents: Intended sales by insiders under Rule 144: shares, approximate date, broker.

entries.name: Registration statement (IPO or other offering)
entries.contents: Full prospectus: business, risk factors, use of proceeds, capitalisation, dilution, financial statements, management, principal shareholders, underwriting.
entries.notes: Amendments (S-1/A) carry the price range; the final terms are in the 424B prospectus.

entries.name: Shelf registration statement
entries.contents: Registers securities to be sold later off the shelf; terms come in later 424B prospectus supplements.

entries.name: Prospectus or prospectus supplement
entries.contents: Final terms of an offering: size, price, coupon or dividend rate, maturity, conversion terms, liquidation preference, use of proceeds, underwriters.
entries.notes: Variants 424B1-424B8 are the same thing under different rules; search all of them. For 'summarise the terms of the Series D preferred', this is the document.

entries.name: Free writing prospectus
entries.contents: Term sheet or pricing sheet circulated during an offering; the quickest statement of final terms.

entries.name: Notice of exempt (private) offering
entries.filer: any issuer, including private companies and funds
entries.contents: Amount offered and sold in a private placement, security type, investors, minimum investment.

entries.name: Communications about a business combination
entries.contents: Press releases, investor decks and transcripts about a pending merger, filed under Rule 425.

entries.name: Tender offer statement (third party)
entries.contents: Offer to purchase: price, conditions, expiry, background.

entries.name: Annual report of a foreign private issuer
entries.filer: foreign private issuer (for example SAP, Sony)
entries.contents: Annual report under IFRS or home GAAP: Item 3 risk factors, 4 business, 5 operating and financial review, 6 directors and compensation, 7 major shareholders, 18 financial statements.
entries.notes: get_financial_fact looks up us-gaap tags; IFRS filers use the ifrs-full taxonomy, so most lookups return 'not found' and the table route is needed. Item numbers differ from the 10-K.

entries.name: Report of a foreign private issuer
entries.cadence: event / monthly / quarterly, whenever home-market disclosure is made
entries.contents: Whatever the issuer publishes at home: quarterly results, monthly revenue (some issuers), press releases, shareholder notices. The 8-K equivalent, but without Item numbers.
entries.notes: Figures are in the home currency (NT$, EUR, JPY); keep the currency and any exchange rate the question supplies. Many 6-Ks per year, so DO NOT rely on full-text search: use list_filings(form_type='6-K', date_from, date_to) by FILING DATE. Monthly revenue reports (TSMC and other Taiwanese issuers) are filed about 10 days after month end, so March revenue is the 6-K filed in the first half of April; open its EX-99.1 and get_table or find_in_document 'net revenue'. Quarterly results 6-Ks are filed in the month after quarter end. Foreign filers have no 10-Q/8-K, and often no us-gaap XBRL (IFRS filers): expect get_financial_fact to be empty and read the exhibits instead.

entries.name: Monthly portfolio holdings report (public version)
entries.filer: registered fund (closed-end fund, ETF, mutual fund)
entries.cadence: monthly; public for the last month of each fiscal quarter, about 60 days later
entries.contents: Every position: name, identifiers, balance, value, percent of net assets, asset category, country; derivatives with counterparty, reference entity or index, notional, termination date, payment legs, upfront, unrealized gain; fund-level assets, liabilities, borrowings, risk metrics.
entries.substance_in: primary_doc.xml (the listed primary document is the rendered page; strip the xsl folder)
entries.notes: Holdings are as of the report date (period), not the filing date; say which. NPORT-EX is the human-readable schedule attached to the same filing. Reference names are free text; merge spellings.

entries.name: Certified annual shareholder report of a registered fund
entries.contents: Audited schedule of investments (derivatives labelled 'buy protection' / 'sell protection'), statements of assets and liabilities and operations, financial highlights (NAV, expense ratio, total return), notes (derivative risk, maximum potential payout on protection sold, leverage, fees), manager's letter.
entries.notes: The notes state the fund's own maximum liability on sold CDS protection: the cross-check for cds_exposure. Large documents (1-2 MB); use find_in_document first.

entries.name: Annual census report of a registered fund
entries.contents: Structured facts about the fund: adviser, sub-advisers, auditor, share classes, leverage used, securities lending, whether it used derivatives, exchange and ticker.

entries.name: Registration statement of a closed-end fund
entries.contents: Investment objective and policies, leverage limits, fees table, risk factors, distribution policy, management.

entries.name: Annual proxy voting record of a fund
entries.contents: How the fund voted on every proxy proposal; since 2024 in XML and covering say-on-pay votes.

entries.name: Note: manager holdings versus fund holdings
entries.contents: 13F-HR is filed by the management company for all its accounts (equities only); N-PORT is filed per registered fund with every asset class. For a hedge fund manager use 13F; for its listed closed-end fund use N-PORT.

entries.name: Annual report of employee stock plans
entries.filer: company with a 401(k)/ESPP holding company stock
entries.contents: Plan financial statements.

entries.name: Specialized disclosure report (conflict minerals)
entries.contents: Conflict minerals due diligence; exhibit holds the report.

entries.name: Asset-backed issuer distribution report
entries.contents: Distribution and pool performance data for securitisations.

entries.name: Annual report to shareholders (glossy)
entries.contents: The printed annual report sent with the proxy; often a PDF.

entries.name: Notice of late filing
entries.contents: Why the 10-K or 10-Q is late and when it is expected; sometimes a preliminary results estimate.

entries.name: Certification of termination of registration
entries.contents: Company is deregistering: going private, delisted, or acquired.

entries.name: Registration of securities (spin-off or direct listing)
entries.contents: Information statement for a spin-off: the new company's business, financials, capital structure.

entries.name: Registration of a class of securities on an exchange
entries.contents: Short form registering shares for exchange listing.

entries.name: Correspondence with the SEC staff
entries.contents: Company's replies to SEC comment letters: explanations of accounting choices, non-GAAP use, segment reporting.
entries.notes: The staff's letters are form type UPLOAD.

entries.name: Notice of effectiveness of a registration statement
entries.contents: One line: the registration became effective on a date.
answers: when did the registration go effective

entries.name: Initial statement of beneficial ownership
entries.contents: Holdings on becoming an insider.

entries.name: Shareholder proxy exempt solicitation
entries.contents: A shareholder's letter urging a vote.
